title: Provision a new board's .kanbus.yml through kanbus-api
description: Follow-up to kbs-9cb5cb40. A new Chatticus bot board needs its .kanbus.yml in scope <tenant>/<project> before issue routes work (otherwise 503 configuration_missing). Add PUT /{tenant}/{project}/api/config that creates the configuration only if absent (WriteCondition::Absent, idempotent by X-Operation-Id), validates it with the Kanbus configuration loader, and is allowed only for principals holding a provisioning grant (designed together with service principals, kbs-f222b6ee). Spec first.
